pull_request.title: Reuse selected saved checkpoint definitions in an editable scope
pull_request.body:
## Why

A creator can already open a saved workspace as a whole or copy a checkpoint within the current draft. Reusing a few definitions from an earlier saved scope otherwise requires manual transcription and risks carrying over the wrong review notes.

## What changes

While editing a draft, **Choose saved checkpoints** admits a version 1 local workspace through the existing strict codec and previews its original definitions with nothing selected. **Add selected checkpoints** appends the chosen rows in source order, including repeated equal rows at separate positions.

The current project fields and existing checkpoints retain their exact strings. Only saved deliverable, amount string and planned evidence are copied. Approval state, accepted or pending review evidence, IDs and simulated payment events do not transfer. Unfinished definition strings remain editable; ordinary review still validates amounts and cap fit. The complete append must fit the existing 12-row limit.

Draft edits, row changes, stage changes and workspace replacement retire stale reads and choices. A successful append clears both file previews, clears pending removal recovery and focuses the first copied deliverable.

## Current-source composition

Built on `paypal-ai` commit `cdffd2476cae0c7332dff64677ae814b7f594947`, including the integrated history, Undo-removal and comparison-export work. The new append explicitly calls the existing `clearDraftRemoval()` structural-action hook; ordinary text edits retain the current Undo behavior. Existing history clear/update and whole-workspace apply bindings remain in place.

The complete tree comparison preserves all 669 current leaves outside the three shared source edits. This commit has 684 leaves: three modified paths and twelve additions, consisting of five new source/test/checker files and seven evidence files. No existing path is deleted. Existing codec, plan, ledger, comparison, dependency and workflow bytes are unchanged.

## Verification and limits

- Original-only contract and native saved-workspace fixture were frozen before implementation. The unchanged baseline passed 49 native tests.
- Seven focused authored native groups passed on the available Node 22 runtime. Supported Node 24 verification is the repository's ordinary hosted `npm test` gate triggered by this PR.
- Actual Chromium receiving preserved seven earlier browser groups plus five groups on the corrected final UI. Exact source pins, browser receipts, screenshots and two actual native-byte-identical downloads are retained. The earlier download-observer correction, stale-chooser same-file retry failure and narrow UI repair, startup timeout and ENOSPC failure remain recorded.
- A distinct independent receiver froze its original-native oracle before candidate access and passed five native groups: literal duplicate/order selection, exact unfinished save, exact capacity-12 save, a fresh review with zero transferred review state, and strict selection/admission refusals. It did not repeat the authored suite.
- Independent current-composition source review and one bounded current-only Undo/import browser witness are in progress. Final integration awaits those results and the supported hosted gate.

[Authored evidence and preserved failure history](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/scopesignal/blob/65209a72c4593358848a6921847a478ce6fba8c3/out/checkpoint-reuse-68094585a1c2/README.md) · [Current composition receipt](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/scopesignal/blob/65209a72c4593358848a6921847a478ce6fba8c3/out/checkpoint-reuse-68094585a1c2/composition-receipt.json)

The original 1,184,761-byte, 134-member authored capsule remains unchanged, SHA-256 `359fbefb48edddd56e9db2bce89c3821529d519b82fc2ad1ba569cb721efeac2`. Its results retain the original `estate-68094585a1c2 / receiving_review` attribution; `scope_receiving` continued integration.

Closes #35.

issue.title: Reuse selected saved checkpoints in an unfinished scope
issue.body:
## Creator outcome

Owner: **estate-68094585a1c2 / receiving_review**, with root retaining independent source acceptance and normal publication/integration under Jacob's standing execution mandate.

A creator should be able to reuse selected checkpoint definitions from an earlier saved fictional workspace while keeping the current unfinished brief and other checkpoints. The existing product offers whole-workspace opening, whole-plan revision downloads and duplication within the current draft; it has no selected saved-checkpoint append flow.

## Exact baseline and preserved ownership

Current default `paypal-ai` is **847505d2fe9f8295110fc13a3fb9e05ec71f6644**, tree **cac1d2bbdd38e2e4c2aed7249c2593ec174c0eaa**. The complete 521-leaf source tree has no AGENTS.md or CONTINUE.md. All 16 selected native/source/test inputs were verified before and after execution.

The original native plan/workspace/revision/form-value tests pass **49/49** on installed Node22.22.1. This is disclosed as native baseline evidence below the declared Node24 support floor; the existing supported hosted gate remains required. The original producer created a reviewed source with distinct planned, accepted and pending evidence and an unknown capture. Actual Chromium153/Puppeteer25 receiving completed three groups across a two-group first run and a one-group continuation: raw unfinished field preservation, real File preview/cancel, then complete workspace replacement and a byte-exact original native download. The actual page has zero selected-checkpoint append entries.

The first receiver incorrectly waited for a new download filename. Chrome had already written the second file under the same fixed filename; its bytes match the native reviewed source. The initial script, timeout and outputs are preserved, and only the remaining boundary was rerun. No product repair is inferred.

Frozen ThinkPad baseline: `/tmp/hamon-scopesignal-checkpoint-import-68094585a1c2`. Contract SHA256 `21ee8b3d2c18bd6589805c02a054698fb6ae38898ac67f10bf11518b7e437daf`; 44-file baseline manifest `04895ecf8a2769b2580ff2517639912118652ed37c9955c84450dd24ee05da61`; receiving receipt `6e9cf0e67102113d10dc8cbfbddb23bca5aa538756fca8534e04c88d2c2ea89c`.

Preserve active **#29 authored decision history**, **#34 removal Undo**, and **#33 comparison export**. #34's current coordination identifies its Undo-clear call at the start of `workspaceChanged` and after `cancelOpen` in actual file apply; the new append must retire that recovery through the existing mutation hook. Neither owner’s source is overwritten. Existing plan, ledger, codec, revision, comparison, export, payment, dependencies and workflows remain exact.

## Frozen behavior

- Available only in the editable draft form. Read one explicitly chosen version-1 workspace, at most1 MiB, through the unchanged strict decoder and fatal UTF-8 admission. Admit saved drafts and saved reviews.
- Preview ordered checkpoint definitions with explicit checkboxes, initially none selected. Show each exact title, raw amount string and planned evidence, including unfinished fields and line breaks.
- **Add selected checkpoints** appends selected rows once each in source order. Existing project fields and rows remain exact. No source project/cap/brief, IDs, accepted or pending review notes, approvals, events or simulated payment state is transferred.
- Repeated equal definitions remain distinct choices. Refuse an empty selection or a whole append exceeding the existing12-row limit; no partial import or deduplication.
- Keep ordinary amount/cap validation at Review. Do not recalculate, normalize or auto-adjust entered amounts or cap.
- File choice/read/preview/cancel/refusal changes no draft. Recheck complete current workspace identity before append. Draft edits/structural changes, review transitions and explicit whole-workspace replacement retire older import work, including delayed reads and same-value roundtrips.
- Successful append retires its file preview, announces the count and focuses the first copied deliverable. It invalidates existing replacement/Undo state through the appropriate native mutation hooks.
- Keyboard/mobile operation, literal text and source custody receive focused actual-browser coverage. No automatic storage, external request, account, library, new file format or provider action.

## Source fence and receiving

New `src/scope-checkpoint-import.mjs`, `src/scope-checkpoint-import-ui.mjs` and `scope-checkpoint-import.css`; narrow mount/current-state/append/invalidation callbacks in `src/scope-workspace.mjs`; a section in `scope.html`; focused native/browser tests, README usage and unique evidence. The shared retirement hooks will be coordinated with #29/#34 before integration.

Implementation occurs only in an owned isolated source copy. Preserve original failures and native inputs, independently challenge selective copying and state interleavings, then qualify exact current-source composition and the repository's ordinary hosted gates. This source claim is not a native goal lease or deployment claim.
